resources.string: Car and garage
The name at the top opens the car list. Garage opens the selected car’s profile.
Tap the car name to switch or add cars. Garage holds the profile, body type and colour.\n\nEach car has its own data. Deleting a car also deletes its history.
Mileage with less effort
Record the actual odometer every week or two. Mileage between readings is estimated automatically.

Record the actual odometer every week or two and after a long drive. Readings from fill-ups count too.\n\n“~” marks an estimate based on previous readings. It is used for maintenance due dates; a new reading improves it.
Fuel use and running cost
Consumption is calculated between entries marked Full tank. Partial fill-ups in between count when the next full tank is recorded.

Calculation needs two entries of the same fuel type marked Full tank. An unmarked fill-up is saved, but does not update consumption on its own.

Record every partial fill-up after a full tank. The next entry marked Full tank updates consumption and cost per distance, including all partial fill-ups in between.

Each fuel type is calculated separately. For electricity, mark charging to the same usual limit instead of a full tank.
Maintenance intervals
Tap the maintenance item itself to adjust its intervals and reminders. Done records completed work.

Tap the maintenance item itself to open its settings. Adjust the distance and time intervals and reminder thresholds there. The item becomes due when either interval is reached first.

Initial intervals are general suggestions; check them against the car’s service schedule.

After the work, tap Done and record its date and mileage. Past dates are supported; mistakes can be corrected in the journal. Set the common notification time and weekdays in More → Reminder settings. Turn off Use common settings for an item to give it a separate schedule. Advanced settings allow warnings before the yellow or red level and limits on repeats. Android may deliver notifications later than the chosen time.
A maintenance list that fits
The button below the list adds an item. Its name, icon and intervals can be adjusted for the car.

Add item below the list creates a maintenance task or consumable. Set its name and intervals; the icon and reminder thresholds are adjustable too.

Full service can be added as a separate item. Record its last completion to calculate the next due date; this does not mark individual parts as replaced.

Tap its card to edit or delete it.
Documents and expiry dates
Insurance and other documents live here. Renewed records an extension; another document can be added below.

Tap a document to see its validity period and history. Renewed records the date used for its next due date.\n\nUse the button below the list for a custom document. Ready-made sets are available in More under Country.
Record a fill-up
Fill-up opens the date, odometer, amount, cost and fuel type. Mark full tank only when the tank was filled completely.

Record the date, odometer, amount, cost and fuel type in Fill-up. Mark Full tank only when filled completely.

Record partial fill-ups too. The next full tank updates consumption and cost per distance, including all partial fill-ups between full tanks. The first calculation needs two full-tank entries of the same fuel type.

Use the journal to edit, delete or move a fill-up to another car.
History for the selected car
The second tab brings together fill-ups, work and renewals. The name at the top switches cars and their history.
Fill-ups, completed work and document renewals for the selected car appear here. Tap the name at the top to switch cars and their history.
Corrections in the journal
Tap an entry to edit it. Press and hold to select several entries for deletion.

Tap an entry to edit its date, mileage and other details. A fill-up can move to another car; a work record can move to another maintenance item.\n\nTo delete several entries, press and hold one, select the rest and tap Delete. Deleting the latest completion makes the due-date calculation use the previous one.
Appearance and language
Choose the theme and language on the third tab. On Android 13 or later, language changes here; older versions follow the phone.

Choose a theme or follow the phone.\n\nOn Android 13 or later, change the app language here; older versions follow the phone. English is used when no translation is available. Language changes leave units and country unchanged.
Familiar units
Distance and fuel can use familiar units. Existing maintenance intervals keep their actual value.

The unit set changes how distance and fuel are displayed. Data and intervals keep their actual values: kilometres, for example, appear as converted miles.\n\nTo change a maintenance interval, tap the item on the home screen.

Country sets the automatic currency and available document templates. Language and units are selected separately.

Choose a country, then use the separate button to add its document set. Missing documents are listed before confirmation.

Existing items are not duplicated, and documents from a previous country remain. If no set fits, add documents manually on the home screen.
@string/more_backup
@string/more_backup_sub

Backup saves data for restoration. Restoring replaces current data with the backup contents.\n\nChoose a folder for weekly copies. Keep it accessible if the phone is lost. After restoring, check settings and the backup folder.
Scanner package
Download the optional package for on-device recognition. You can recognize a photo on this device. Check the result before saving.

Download the optional package for on-device recognition. You can recognize a photo on this device. Check the result before saving.

The source in our GitHub repository and the size appear before download. Files are checked on the phone; photos and car records are not sent.

Versions and updates shows changes and lets you check for updates. Preview versions are labelled separately. Packages incompatible with the app cannot be installed.

Choosing a version does not download it; confirm the download separately. The current package stays until the new one installs successfully. A saved previous version can be restored without internet access.

Remove packages deletes all versions and unfinished downloads. Car history is preserved.

Open reminders in More. Choose the local time and any days of the week, for example Wednesday only. Open advanced settings to set how far before the yellow or red level to warn you, the interval between repeats and the notification limit.

To use a different schedule for one item or document, open it and turn off shared settings. Save your changes.

Repeats arrive only on the selected weekdays, at most once a day per item. Reaching yellow or red starts a new stage with a fresh count.

Local time on your phone. Android may deliver a reminder later to save battery.

0 means no limit. The count starts over when you record the service as done.
@string/settings_currency
The currency follows the selected country. You can choose another manually; it stays selected when you change country. Choose “Use country currency” to return to automatic mode.

The currency follows the selected country. You can choose another manually; it stays selected when you change country. Choose “Use country currency” to return to automatic mode.\n\nApplies to all cars. Changing currency only changes the label: saved amounts are not converted.

@string/more_export_summary

Choose the car and either a short overview or the full history. Add your own question if needed and choose whether to hide the VIN and car name.\n\nOpen the preview and check the text, especially notes: hiding the identifiers does not remove personal information from free text. Copy, share or save the reviewed version. For a large history, save a file and attach it to your chat. Nothing is sent automatically.
